**•** Serve as a primary customer interface throughout project delivery, maintaining effective customer communication and coordinating with Customer Success Managers and other stakeholders to align delivery with applicable service requirements.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Join us as a Project Engineer and bring your technical skills to projects that matter.The Project Engineer is an entry-level, field-based engineering role supporting the installation, startup, testing, and commissioning of building automation, HVAC, electrical, and energy-efficient building systems. Working primarily at active project sites, this role partners with project managers, engineers, subcontractors, commissioning teams, and clients to ensure systems are installed safely, meet project requirements, and operate as intended. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys combining hands-on technical work, problem-solving, and collaboration in a construction environment.

**What will you do?**

* Support the installation, startup, testing, and commissioning of building automation, HVAC, electrical, and low-voltage control systems.
* Review drawings, wiring diagrams, equipment submittals, sequences of operation, and project documents to verify proper system installation and performance.
* Coordinate and monitor subcontractor activities, site logistics, installation schedules, safety requirements, and quality standards.
* Troubleshoot sensors, actuators, controllers, wiring, networks, variable frequency drives, equipment alarms, and system operation, escalating complex issues when needed.
* Document field conditions, deficiencies, test results, equipment information, drawing updates, and project progress using appropriate digital tools.
* Partner with project managers, engineers, subcontractors, commissioning teams, and client facility personnel to resolve issues and keep projects on schedule.
* Support client training, system demonstrations, project turnover, and continuous improvement while maintaining Schneider Electric safety and quality standards.
